status: Benchmark diagnostics implementation committed; no parser optimization admitted in this investigation.
toolTitle: test: report JIT events by benchmark phase
changes: --jit records phase-tagged V8 compile starts/completions, optimization completions, dependent-code invalidations and bailouts; raw logs are hashed and retained.
Diagnostic reports do not produce throughput comparisons or remark estimates and cannot be used as performance references.
--settle-rounds declares 1-16 post-GC rounds of 150ms each; worker propagation, bounded duration, incremental edit phase and reference compatibility are checked. Default protocol remains one round.
document/spec is available alongside one-shot CommonMark cases.
Measurement markers bracket the timed loop; CPU/heap bookkeeping is outside these phase markers.

rawReportScope: The full reports, including every JIT event, are retained as hashed compressed artifacts. The readable report copies replace event lines with counts by phase.
protocol: Every command uses taskpolicy -c utility. Fresh process/module each observation, alternating ABBA/BAAB, ~300ms measured and <=500ms per warmup/settling/measurement window, full GC before settling, natural GC retained. No own builds/tests/profiles overlapped throughput. All samples retained. The two JIT runs are diagnostics, not performance evidence.
controlInterpretation: Both slots use the same frozen bundle. The four-block ordinary control is -2.6600%, CI[-5.4115,+0.1715]; zero is included. This is not a speedup and illustrates why point estimates cannot admit a candidate.
runtimeFinding: The document diagnostic captures 48 dependent-code invalidations in post-warmup full GC and 115 optimization completions during measurement. The final incremental two-round diagnostic has 206 optimization completions during measurement with no measured invalidations/bailouts. Event counts are not unique-function counts. More settling does not automatically establish JIT quiescence.
coverageLimits: No automatic stable-tier guarantee, no diagnosis of the exact cause of the pending shortcutIdentifier regression, and no new parser/remark speed claim. Typecheck and lint passed. Two executed intermediate tool revisions were reconstructed and hash-verified against their reports before final measurement markers/diagnostic display were adjusted; both are archived. The final revision has a full 16-observation JIT round-propagation run, a normal worker smoke check and negative CLI checks.

screenedStructuralIdeas.sourceOrder: Current physical source projection already acquires parent starts before children and ends afterward; BlockLines.locationAt is a forward-only cursor. No new position-order rewrite was needed.
screenedStructuralIdeas.mappingDisposition: Deferred without implementation or a throughput claim: spec has 882 segmented searches / 2424 binary-search steps; dense quote stress is much larger. SourceView callers can map a leaf end before finishing preceding text and revisit a hard-break end, so a monotonic-only segment cursor is not justified by the physical locator invariant.
screenedStructuralIdeas.emissionDisposition: Deferred without implementation: 82 spec emissions only prune raw candidates, involving 347 input records and 65 semantic output records. Passing raw candidates through would shift work into AST projection and change the resolved-stream contract; the counter alone does not justify that tradeoff.
